article_title: Database of ab initio L-edge X-ray absorption near edge structure

figure4.method: Original vector line vertices and axis tick positions; affine calibration from labelled ticks.
figure4.transformations: Axis-coordinate calibration; retain literal display intensity and separately subtract visual offsets 0,0.55,1.1. No reconstruction from release data.
figure4.visible_only_note: PDF paths extend beyond axis clips; only the visible portion is valid published comparison evidence.
figure4.uncertainty: Original vector coordinates eliminate raster digitization error. Printed line widths and path simplification still limit meaningful plot comparison precision.

figure2.method: Manual literal transcription of every numbered element cell, checked against retained full-size publisher image.
figure2.site_averaged_definition: Per-element crystal count with complete corresponding L2 and L3 site-wise spectra.
figure2.site_wise_definition: Either L2 or L3 spectrum for one absorbing site.

figure5.restriction: Opacity is not an empirical quantile, a class count, or a recoverable per-trace distribution. Preserve literal figure for comparative review; do not fabricate pointwise targets.
